question_and_initial_information: 发现任务，Opaque无世界模型。自主固定水0.08 L、试剂0.04 mol、催化剂0.005 mol、500 rpm；任务提示涉及淬灭/终止，但未提供其结果。
expectations: v1已提出淬灭可能停止反应；v2在4催化剂筛选后写温度/时间预期；v3提出即时淬灭与未淬灭等待；v4在batch11显示冷却仍反应后，事前预测batch12淬灭后等长等待若停止反应则conversion约0.42而非0.62。
tests_and_observations: 88动作全提交。四催化剂360K1800s同条件；B水330/390/420K1800s；390K600/3600s；390K1800s即时淬灭；同加热后等待1800s；淬灭后等待1800s。笔记cursor0/28/63/79/88。直接终止batch6 conversion0.41718/yield0.31666/deg0.01414；未淬灭等待batch11冷却44.31K，conversion0.61847/yield0.41778/deg0.05233；即时淬灭batch10 conversion0.41832/yield0.29303；淬灭后等待batch12 conversion0.42724/yield0.30652/deg0.01561。淬灭45K降温约55s，且后续wait温度不变。
revisions: v4由未淬灭冷却仍继续反应更新热历史解释；下一批在事前预测后验证淬灭等待基本保持化学终点，v5把淬灭操作下的反应抑制列为强支持。K1仍保留并行支路、产物降解、催化失活等候选，承认尚无目标产物随时间下降的直接证据。
later_use: Q把淬灭后末态风险降低及化学基本不变迁移到乙腈小体积新条件，并预计Q07/Q08末态风险差异0.67/0.20；参考0.4353/0.2050。源从未采乙腈，Q总体仍有yield MAE0.18893、conversion MAE0.10561、risk MAE0.11767。推荐batch11等待方案，复测score0.23177、yield0.41031。形成局部关系并不保证域外数值准确。
unresolved: 淬灭前后的温度轨迹未严格匹配；batch12与11同时改变淬灭状态和冷却轨迹，所以参与者所称不只是冷却的唯一解释并未被此设计完全识别。可以说操作性抑制后续变化获得支持，不能把完全非热的化学停止机制定为已证明。v4有同期预期，但不应借其自称preregistered误称研究者正式预注册。

anchors.quote: If quench arrests chemistry, final conversion should remain near the quenched/direct-termination region (~0.42) rather than the unquenched-wait value (~0.62), and degradation should remain low.
Thus quench arrests the reactive network in this scope rather than merely providing equivalent passive cooling.
Because temperature and elapsed cooling time changed together, the experiment does not locate the precise temperature window responsible for this conversion.
Therefore, quenching changes more than the thermal trajectory: operationally, it suppresses the reactive network to nearly zero on the timescale tested.
Ending at 390 K should give a much lower terminal safety-risk reading than ending at 450 K.
Yield continued to rise through Batch 9, so there was no direct observation of P decreasing with time.
The point model effectively assumed that these changes caused only moderate kinetic scaling and did not reverse selectivity trends. That assumption had no direct experimental support.
